def test_file_response_range_ignore_non_numeric(file_response_client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = file_response_client.get("/", headers={"Range": "bytes=abc-def, 0-50"})
    assert response.status_code == 206
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes 0-50/{len(README.encode('utf8'))}"


def test_file_response_suffix_range(file_response_client: TestClient) -> None:
    # Test suffix range (last N bytes) - line 523 with empty start_str
    response = file_response_client.get("/", headers={"Range": "bytes=-100"})
    assert response.status_code == 206
    file_size = len(README.encode("utf8"))
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes {file_size - 100}-{file_size - 1}/{file_size}"
    assert response.headers["content-length"] == "100"
    assert response.content == README.encode("utf8")[-100:]

    response = file_response_client.get("/", headers={"Range": "bytes=0-100"})
    assert response.status_code == 206

item.text: The defect is isolated to suffix parsing: it computes `file_size - requested_suffix`, which becomes negative and is rejected as unsatisfiable. I’ll clamp only that computed start to zero and add a focused regression covering status, complete body, `Content-Range`, and `Content-Length`.
The minimal code and regression-test changes are in place. I’m running the new focused test first; its assertions directly cover every contract requirement.
The focused test runner produced no result within its initial window. Per the repository instructions, I’m making one bounded retry with an explicit timeout and preserving the runner’s exit status.

The bounded retry timed out after 30 seconds with no output, so I’m stopping test-runner attempts as required. I’m doing the final scope and whitespace review now; the verification gap will be reported explicitly.
